body:
> @sushreebarsa I was able to reproduce the issue on Colab using TF v2.11. Please find the gist [here](https://colab.research.google.com/gist/tiruk007/9bf09f6466ba93b05f608f2f10a9346b/58696.ipynb) for reference.
> 
> Thank you!

I found that many operators (tf.math.reduce_mean, tf.math.reduce_std, etc.) have this problem, and then using the same code, by comparing the results of Tensorflow2.11 and Tensorflow2.10 versions, I found that
`6034766930529145842` may mean `DT_INT8, DT_COMPLEX64, DT_INT64, DT_QINT8, DT_QUINT8, DT_QINT32, DT_BFLOAT16`.

Initial debug details:
It should raise an error with the following allowed list here https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/blob/master/tensorflow/core/ops/ops.pbtxt#L12046-L12113.
But it is skipping:
```
        type: DT_INT8
        type: DT_COMPLEX64
        type: DT_INT64
        type: DT_QINT8
        type: DT_QUINT8
        type: DT_QINT32
        type: DT_BFLOAT16 
```
and showing below list with random number included. 
`[DT_FLOAT, DT_DOUBLE, DT_INT32, DT_UINT8, DT_INT16, 6034766930529145842, DT_UINT16, DT_COMPLEX128, DT_HALF, DT_UINT32, DT_UINT64]`
Are you satisfied with the resolution of your issue? Yes No

To answer the question, it was a random fingerprint that we used internally to represent a bunch of types not listed, in order to reduce the length of the string.

It will now report all types.
